ruling.recommended_action: Close the dispute as no refund due; note RD-1/RD-5 consent record on file (no account flag warranted).

segment_findings.reason: Off-route segment 10:04–10:07 (1.94 km vs 0.22 km optimal, +1.73 km) was preceded by the driver's request at 10:01 [F7] and the rider's explicit agreement at 10:01 [F8], both timestamped before the segment start; driver statement [F9] corroborates. Consent was obtained before leaving the optimal route, so the segment is exempt under RD-5 (no_action for this segment; RD-4 not required).

rejected_claims.reason: Billed distance equals the optimal 9.9 km [F4]; no surge [F5]; total $23.32 consists solely of published fare components [F6]. RydeX is a fixed-quote non-metered service, so the extra 1.8 km driven [F1] did not increase the fare — no amount was overcharged (FARE-1, RD-2 non-metered branch).
The sole deviation [F3] was covered by the rider's prior agreement to the Halus Link routing, so it is exempt under RD-5 and no refund attaches.
